plan.title: Single-Stage RFQ Upload with Bad Row

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Provide the mandatory event title for a create flow.
Apply the RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the known CYLINDER product through the supported product-selection flow.
Verify the product's variant is populated as specified.
Enter the requested quantity for the first product row.
Upload the closest available fixture in place of the required three-row workbook.
Check for the expected one-row upload failure message.
Verify that the failed-row details can be opened.
Check that the two good uploaded rows plus the existing product row are represented.
